# simulator.setDateTime

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Set the date & time.

```lua
simulator.setDateTime(table)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `table` |  | yes | { sec, min, hour, day, month, year, lock } |

## Returns

Nothing.
